label: Redaction runs once in the core before projection, so search, previews, part lists and pages all read already-redacted text.
redactArgument redacts a string argument only when its key matches SECRET_ARGUMENT_KEY; every other string falls through to a value-only pattern scan.
SECRET_ARGUMENT_KEY does not match a prefixed header name, so a short credential under x-api-key survives both the key rule and the text scan.
The scrubber's credential-assignment pattern requires a 20-character value, so a short token is invisible to text scanning even when the key is spelled out.
The Pi reader proves the session header id and cwd against the caller's project directory and returns session_mismatch on any failure.
The OpenCode reader skips the project proof when the store has no directory column, so a same-id session from another project is accepted and served.
The 160-character preview cut hides the detail a lookup is for: the side word sits at character 295 of a 425-character sender turn, so only load or page reaches it.
The OpenCode receiver succeeded because it loaded the sender's first user turn instead of reading a preview.
